ext.description: Unofficial NetCOBOL (fixed format) support: syntax highlighting, Shift_JIS byte-accurate column checks, sequence number renumbering, outline and go to definition.
cfg.columnCounting: How to count columns for the fixed format (sequence 1-6, indicator 7, area A 8-11, area B 12-72, identification 73-80).
cfg.columnCounting.shiftjis: Shift_JIS bytes: full-width characters count as 2 columns, ASCII and half-width katakana as 1 (matches NetCOBOL on Shift_JIS sources).
cfg.columnCounting.utf8: UTF-8 bytes: for sources compiled as UTF-8.
cfg.diagnostics.maxLineLength: Warn when a line exceeds this many columns (0 = off).
cfg.diagnostics.disabledRules: Diagnostic rule codes to turn off, e.g. ["NC010"].
cfg.dimFixedAreas: Dim the sequence area (columns 1-6) and identification area (columns 73-80).
cmd.showDataLayout: Show Data Item Layout (offsets and sizes)
cfg.sequence.start: First number used when renumbering the sequence area (columns 1-6).
cfg.sequence.step: Increment used when renumbering the sequence area.
cfg.copybook.paths: Folders searched for copybooks (`COPY name`) after the folder of the current file. Relative paths are resolved from the workspace folder; `${workspaceFolder}` is supported. `COPY name OF lib` also looks in a sub-folder named `lib`.
cfg.copybook.extensions: File extensions tried for a copybook name, in order (matched case-insensitively). "" means the name as written.
cfg.sourceFormat: Source reference format (NetCOBOL compiler option SRF).
cfg.sourceFormat.auto: Read @OPTIONS SRF(...) in the source; fixed format when absent.
cfg.sourceFormat.fixed: Fixed format: columns 73-80 are the identification area.
cfg.sourceFormat.variable: Variable format: no right margin after column 72.
cfg.sourceFormat.free: Free format: column checks, dimming and renumbering are off.
